summary: Phase 59 frontend tested end-to-end against https://lnmo-fees.preview.emergentagent.com. (1) FeesDemo (/login/p50demo, admin@feesdemo.test/admin123): fee-structure-apply-<id> on 'LP Fees 2026-27' shows toast with 'View details'; bulk-result-dialog shows 2 rows with human reason 'Already has an account for 2026-27 under \'LP Fees 2026-27\'', chips bulk-chip-all/ok/skipped/failed, bulk-csv-btn, bulk-retry-btn all present; bulk-fix-* 'Open ledger' navigates to /app/fees?tab=accounts&account=<id> correctly. Last-apply pill fee-structure-last-apply-<id> shows 'Last apply: 2 skipped · Details' and re-opens the same dialog. Bell notification (type bulk_result) with title "Apply 'LP Fees 2026-27' to students" opens /app/bulk-runs/<id> (bulk-run-page) rendered with full detail. GET /api/notifications and /api/bulk-runs both 200. Generate invoices on TEST not clicked. (2) Sunrise (/login/sunrise): admin@sunrise-demo.in Settings → quick-replies-settings → quick-replies-suggest-btn adds 6 replies first click (toast 'Added 6 suggested replies'), second click toast 'Suggested replies are already there'; quick-replies-new-btn → quick-reply-editor → title/text/save works; quick-reply-edit-<id> and quick-reply-remove-<id> work. In /app/parent-messages Aarav thread chat-quick-replies-btn opens quick-reply-picker; picking a reply fills chat-input with placeholders replaced ({parent_name}=Priya Menon, {child_name}=Aarav Menon, {school_name}=Sunrise Public School (Demo), {fee_due}=₹15,750, {next_due_date}=2026-09-30); typing '/' alone also opens picker. Admin picker does NOT show lakshmi's personal reply. Lakshmi (lakshmi@sunrise-demo.in, /teacher/parent-messages): quick-reply-save-personal saved 'TEST Lakshmi Personal 59' and appears in picker with 'mine' label (left live - see cleanup). (3) Realtime two-context (Lakshmi teacher + parent.menon parent): chat-live-status data-status='live' on both; teacher saw 'Priya is typing…' (chat-typing) within ~2s of parent typing; teacher's sent msg appeared on parent chat-messages within ~3s; teacher side has chat-seen-<id> after parent viewed; teacher chat-toggle-status Close → parent sees chat-closed-note live; Reopen clears it live; portal-bell-badge went from None → 1 after teacher sent while parent was on /parents/dashboard. (4) Fallback polling: WS was blocked in a separate context via init-script (both throwing-constructor and async-error variants). While parent portal loaded and parent-thread list rendered, chat-thread would not render reliably inside the WS-mock context (likely because the mock interferes with chatSocket's internal state). I was unable to complete a clean browser-based end-to-end assertion that chat-live-status transitions to data-status='polling' and a message arrives within ~10-12s. Backend WS verified by main agent via tests/test_phase59.py (4 passed) and python WS client; polling endpoint reachable.

integration_issues.issue: Could not reliably trigger the data-status='polling' fallback in a Playwright context by overriding window.WebSocket. Live WS path works perfectly; backend tests cover polling. Recommend adding a localStorage or query-param hook (e.g. ?chatForcePoll=1) to force the polling path for QA purposes, which would make this verifiable from the UI side.

action_items: (Optional, test-ergonomics) Add a dev-only override (e.g. localStorage.setItem('chatForcePoll','1')) that forces chatSocket to skip the WS path, so UI tests can assert the 'Reconnecting…' → 'Auto-refresh' / data-status='polling' transition deterministically. The live WS path is working end-to-end today.

Cleanup (optional): Lakshmi has one personal quick reply 'TEST Lakshmi Personal 59' and the chat with Priya has several QA messages (RT-test teacher …, RT-badge …, FB-poll…) + the admin posted a quick-reply-filled fee reminder. Admin posted no personal quick replies.
